doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Edna working with De De in New Orleans at the Cat and Fiddle and the pig pen
summary: Edna visited New Orleans and worked with De De for some months in the French Quarter; Billie recalls the club on Dolphin and the old pig pen.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did she ever play with any bands or come to New Orleans?
Yeah, she was, she's been in several times, I mean, since I've been married to Didi.
She worked with me for a while up in French Quarters.
Yeah, years back. Four or five months she worked with me studying.
Yeah, she came here and I, you worked at the Cat and Phil. Cat and Phil, that's on. Right there on, on Dolphin and, uh,
Just block the side of what they call, used to call it a coconut rope, used to be the pig pen. Oh, sure, I remember that.
Yeah. Yeah, I remember. Once when, when Piku played there. Yeah, me and Piku worked there together. Yeah, yeah.
Me and Piku worked at the pig pen together.
